PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: location-hells-gate-the-fortress-entrance-wide-shot
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Location guard: transfer only color, light behavior, haze, scale language, and material realism. Do not copy the reference cave, Hell gate, fortress geometry, crowds, or blocking unless this row explicitly requires those elements.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
HELL'S GATE - THE FORTRESS ENTRANCE — WIDE SHOT: CINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT, SCALE, LIGHTING, MATERIALS, AND CONTINUITY.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

RICH PHOTOREALISTIC LOCATION DETAIL LOCK
---------------------------------------
The generated image must feel like a final live-action cinema plate, not a loose concept sketch. Fill the frame with physically believable environmental detail at foreground, midground, and background depth: chipped stone edges, fractured strata, mineral veins, soot stains, ash drifts, dust settled into cracks, rough tool marks, eroded masonry, scorch halos around heat sources, subtle moisture or polished wear where appropriate, and tiny atmospheric particles catching the light. Preserve coherent perspective, grounded gravity, readable scale relationships, and material continuity across every surface.

Use photorealistic lens behavior: natural 2.39:1 cinematic composition unless the workflow is vertical, deep but controlled atmospheric perspective, realistic depth of field, restrained anamorphic character, high dynamic range, natural motion-free stillness, no over-sharpened CGI sheen, no painterly brush texture, no miniature look, no plastic surfaces, no generic fantasy castle shortcuts. Lighting must be physically motivated by visible practical sources, divine shafts, embers, torches, sky glow, or bounce light; every highlight should have a plausible source and every shadow should wrap naturally around form.

Location richness requirement: the environment should be independently useful as a production reference. Include enough readable architecture, terrain, negative space, texture hierarchy, and weathering to support multiple later shots. Avoid empty backgrounds, flat walls, smooth generic floors, duplicated decorative patterns, random symmetry, collage layouts, title text, labels, captions, borders, watermarks, modern objects, modern lighting rigs, and any graphic design elements. If characters or souls are described by the specific asset prompt, keep them secondary to the location geography and integrate them naturally into the physical space.

Cinematic epic wide establishing shot of Hell's Gate, the fortress entrance at the heart of a subterranean cathedral of suffering, captured at the moment before divine intrusion when the realm still belongs wholly to darkness. At frame center rises THE GATE itself: a pair of colossal double doors fused from blackened iron and human bone into a single seamless architecture of damnation, standing approximately one hundred feet tall and sixty feet wide, so massive that human scale is reduced to insignificance at their base. The gate surface is an unbroken bas-relief of eternal torment—thousands of damned faces carved and cast into the iron-bone composite, mouths frozen open in silent millennial screams, eyes hollow, cheeks sunken, every contorted visage readable in the raking light as both decoration and prison. Iron plates show centuries of corrosion: rust blooming in deep red-brown streaks, pitted black scale, oxidized edges flaking into ash. Bone elements fuse into the metal as ribs, skull fragments, and spinal columns that spiral through the structure like load-bearing veins. Corroded bronze fittings—hinges the size of siege engines, bands, and lockworks—cling to the vertical seam and outer edges, green-black verdigris mixed with dried blood stains that run in long vertical rivulets down the face of the doors.

The gate is set within a crumbling cyclopean archway spanning roughly one hundred fifty feet, supported by twin flanking pillars of polished black stone and obsidian, each pillar approximately twenty feet in diameter, rising into a ceiling lost in smoke and shadow. The stone is veined with faint dying embers, hairline cracks glowing dull red from deep within the rock. Iron reinforcement bands wrap the pillars at intervals, black and corroded. Beyond and around the entrance, the fortress wall continues as a vast cliff of the same black stone, receding into atmospheric depth with smaller torch niches, iron sconces, and rough-hewn architectural relief. The floor before the gate is a dark stone plaza cracked by age and pressure, littered with fine ash drifts, scattered bone fragments, and faint scorch patterns. Low ground smoke crawls across the plaza in lazy sheets, feeding upward into thicker suspended ash and soot that hang like a false sky.

Blue torches burn along the walls and pillar bases—cold spectral flames approximately 2000K, royal-blue to ice-blue, casting elongated dancing shadows that stretch across the gate face like grasping hands. A secondary red underglow from fissures and vents in the floor, roughly 3500K, licks the lower third of the doors and pillars with deep crimson, staining the iron-bone carvings with hellish warmth from below while the upper architecture remains colder and bluer. Ambient hell light is otherwise scarce: deep crimson accents (#8B0000 range) in the mid-ground stone, true obsidian blacks (#0A0A0A) in unlit recesses, volumetric shafts of blue torch light cutting through thick particulate fog. No golden divine radiance yet—this is pure pre-arrival fortress atmosphere: oppressive, ancient, absolute.

Camera: ultra-wide cinematic still, approximately 24mm to 28mm equivalent, dramatic low angle from the plaza floor looking slightly upward so the gate and arch dominate the vertical frame and the ceiling vanishes into smoke; full 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen composition with deep focus across the plaza mid-ground into the gate plane, slight atmospheric haze soft-focusing the farthest wall recesses. Photoreal live-action production photography language: real stone grain, real metal corrosion, real bone texture, physically plausible light falloff, no stylized illustration, no fantasy cartoon materials. Atmosphere: continuous smoke rising from ground level, ash particles suspended and drifting through torch beams, subtle heat shimmer near flame sources against the surrounding cold of the abyss. Moisture and condensation film the lower metal; dried blood darkens the bronze fittings; fine black dust coats horizontal ledges.

Continuity locks for this location state: gate fully intact, sealed, no spiderweb cracks, no molten edges, no golden light bleed through the doors; torches strictly blue flame only, never gold; materials strictly iron-and-bone fusion for the doors with corroded bronze accents and black obsidian-stone architecture; no modern objects, no machinery, no readable inscriptions or carved lettering, no logos, no human figures required in this pure architecture establishing frame though optional distant tiny silhouettes of armored guardians may appear at the extreme base for scale only if kept small and non-focal. Color grade: crushed blacks, deep crimson midtones, cold blue specular accents on metal edges, desaturated bone ivory and ash gray, heavy atmospheric perspective. Sacred biblical-epic tone of overwhelming dread and architectural power—Hell as fortress and cathedral, not carnival—photoreal, reverent, monumental, and still.
